All potentials are genuine canonical quasi-psh representatives, with pole values included. A smooth real (1,1) background theta is big if theta+dd^c rho>=epsilon h for a genuine potential rho, a Hermitian h and epsilon>0; it need not be closed. Ordinary order u preceq v means u<=v+C, and equivalence is mutual order. I(tu) uses |g|^2 exp(-tu), with no extra factor 2; ideal equivalence means equality at every real t>0. Original S11 asks for a restricted positivity invariant for general nonclosed backgrounds and its relation to intrinsic multiplier-ideal traces, and for conditions making positive residual or restricted mass yield a strict current in a specified one-sided or ordinary type. Declare the target submanifold or singular subvariety, the resolution and pullback background, and every finiteness and class choice. These closed/bounded-residual constructions and obstructions are not new answers to the general nonclosed programme. No new invariant, family, strict-current criterion or proof is supplied.
completionCriteria: Construct and prove a substantive restricted positivity invariant beyond the closed or bounded-residual regimes, with precise gauge and modification laws and a nonvacuous genuinely nonclosed example. Establish a rigorous relation to the intrinsic ideal trace data and prove sufficient strict-current conditions with the claimed one-sided or mutual ordinary-type comparison distinguished. Do not identify a nonclosed background with line-bundle curvature, deduce exact trace orders from lower inequalities, use top mass as a complete intrinsic trace invariant, or restate a known closed residual polynomial.
